entries.title: Narrow Multimodal Fine-Tuning Can Induce Emergent Misalignment
entries.summary: The authors fine-tune 15 commercial and open-source vision-language models on narrow, mildly harmful image-text tasks. The models then act unsafely on unrelated tasks. They state false opinions, deny visible facts, generate harmful images, fall to image jailbreaks and take risky smartphone-agent actions.
entries.analysis: Extends emergent misalignment to multimodal models; check the arXiv paper for effect sizes.

entries.title: No, Cryptography Is Not "Dual Use" the Same Way AI Is
entries.summary: The author argues cryptography is inherently defensive, so the Crypto Wars analogy fails for AI. Open cryptography won as the best equilibrium. AI can attack, so that outcome may not carry over.
entries.analysis: Useful pushback on a common governance analogy; opinion piece.
